source_bound_failure_trace.interpretation: Both failures expose frame-local centroid switching when a full corridor is unavailable. The fixed-row width veto is too strict to act when obstacle-adjacent rows are missing and too weak to prevent a switch to a consistently narrower side. A temporally associated obstacle and conservative switch condition are the next diagnostic hypotheses, not validated repairs.
